title: Rename run.rs to run/mod.rs with no behavior change
summary: Retry of structure pass R1: move crates/athena-core/src/run.rs to run/mod.rs unchanged, so the `run` module path stays the same. The only text edits are the two test-module include_str! paths, which need one more `../`, plus a CHANGELOG entry.

defaults_applied.how: test list compared before and after
criteria rest on commands the verifier runs itself
pure rename plus two path edits and a changelog entry
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Retry of the rejected R1 job with the same reading as the earlier accepted one; no findings were recorded.
run_pin_tests.rs is a sibling file referenced via #[path] or similar; check it still resolves after the move, since a path attribute in mod.rs resolves relative to run/ and may need an edit.
Audience is the owner and verifier applying the section 5 proof.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-core/src/run.rs no longer exists and crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs holds its text; git diff -M shows a rename whose only changed lines are the two include_str! paths (athena.toml, defaults.toml) gaining one ../.

No file outside crates/athena-core/src/run/ names a moved item by an old module path: a Grep the verifier runs for `run::` and `mod run` over crates/ shows the same paths resolving, and `pub mod run;` in lib.rs is unchanged.
Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core -- --list` on the change and on the parent commit (via git show/diff); the test names are identical in count and content.
`cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked` pass, and no #[allow] is added.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry saying run.rs became run/mod.rs with no behavior change.
